source_caption_text:
Future stopped Durk from leaving just to play “Hellcats & Trackhawks” 😂🔥

Via @rollingloud

Future brought Lil Durk out during his headlining set at Rolling Loud Miami 2022, where Durk performed “AHHH HA” before making his way off the stage. It looked like his appearance was over after just one song, but Future clearly had other plans.

As Durk started heading toward the exit, Future stopped him and told him he couldn’t leave after performing only one song. He then immediately brought in “Hellcats & Trackhawks,” sending Durk straight back into the performance.

The moment was a perfect example of how these two can feed off each other on stage. Future wasn’t letting Durk leave that easily, and the crowd got an unexpected bonus performance out of it.

#future #lildurk #live
